answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1046 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the anchor. The juniper index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the nectar queue while genuine members promoted earlier goes on earning. That is 9 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
